description: Techno-Economic Energy Dataset for Open Modelling of Decarbonization Pathways in Seaports is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Almeida João (INESC TEC). The data provided were gathered for the assessment of decarbonization pathways in seaports, namely in the use case of the Port of Sines, using the OSeMOSYS framework. However, the data available through this repository are independent of the tool. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
